name: VolumeBooster
description: Allows you to set the user and stream volume above the default maximum
summary: User volume sliders go past 200% (up to 1,000%)
notes: The user volume sliders in the voice window go up to 200% times the multiplier (400% by default) instead of 200%; turning the plugin off or lowering the multiplier brings louder users back down to the new limit. Qord mixes voice itself, so a boosted user is simply amplified (and may clip, as with upstream's gain node).
gaps: Qord has no stream volume control yet, so only user volumes are boosted.
Upstream's slider markers are 0.5 apart; Qord offers the same values as a list.
